decoding.reasoning_mode: thinking_level=high (thoughts not returned; thought tokens billed but invisible)

design.excluded: none: 3000/3000 clean (1 transient API error resumed to completion)

normalization.why: generation hygiene flagged 72% markdown and 100% title lines (formatting the plain-prose human baseline lacks; guard: experiments/ablation/generation_hygiene.py). Uniform R1-6 protocol: every leg is normalized before scoring.
normalization.effect: scored on normalized text; raw scoring archived beside the normalized eval on the HF dataset.

scoring.test: one paired Wilcoxon signed-rank per (mode, metric) over 200 seed-averaged headline pairs, delta = human - model

generation.driver: bench/run.py (google provider, thinking_level=high, max_tokens 16000, checkpoint-resumable JSONL)

duration: ~3h API run (8 workers), single-cell resume for 1 transient error
cost_usd: $26.17 visible from telemetry: 2,260,446 in @ $2/M + 1,804,284 candidates-out @ $12/M; thought tokens (thinking_level=high) billed but not itemized by the harness (known telemetry gap, fix queued: record thoughts_token_count)
headline_finding: Textbook headline pattern at frontier scale: human text far burstier in control (B_n +0.128, rb +0.85, p~0), instruction narrows the gap (+0.071) but does not close it (still p~0). Strongest control-mode dispersion gap of any family measured.
provenance: Generated via the Gemini API against pinned prompts; hygiene-gated, normalized (R1-6 uniform protocol), and scored locally against the frozen human baseline on the post-R1-5 metric; compiled eval carried into the repo as SSOT.
